$comment: EOS Ownership Model v1 — PROPOSED operating-company assignment for the sandbox physical roots.
STATUS: PROPOSAL. Every assignment below is null and NOTHING has been written. This file is the
shape of the decision, not the decision.
WHY THE VALUES ARE NULL RATHER THAN FILLED IN. A physical root's company is a primary business
fact. Nothing on these records can supply it: the names ('Main Distribution Center', 'North
Satellite', 'Truck 101 - North Valley') are display text, and inferring a company from display
text is prohibited by ruling D-9. Filling these in would have been invention, so each one is
left for the Owner to state.
MEASURED CORRECTION TO THE FIRST PLAN. It listed four root families and 19 records. The
referential derivation check found two of them are not roots:
- stock_locations is a per-warehouse-per-part BALANCE record, not a place. 5/5 derive from
- trucks carry homeWarehouseId. 2/2 derive from their home warehouse.
Only warehouses and mobile_locations are primary: 12 decisions, not 19.
The two 'mobile-seed…' rows and the two TRK-SEED trucks are duplicates of the same physical
vehicles across two collections (ADR-010 models a truck as a MOBILE location). Assigning the
mobile_location is what matters; the truck row derives.
Once every 'operatingCompanyId' below is a governed id ('taylor' or 'ventana'), 129 measured
descendant records become derivable and 47 transfer orders resolve to a participating pair.

derivedNotRoots.$comment: Measured DERIVABLE by scripts/ownershipDerivationCheck.js. Listed so nobody re-adds them as roots.
